summary: The AI-Based Smart Butterfly is a project that combines Artificial Intelligence, wireless communication and motor control technology. The system uses an AI chip to process input signals and control the butterfly model. The transmitter and receiver (TX & RX) are used for wireless communication. The battery supplies power to the system, and the motor helps in controlling the butterfly movement. The project is designed using MATLAB Simulink to simulate and observe the system's working process. This project demonstrates how AI and electronic components can work together to create an intelligent and controlled butterfly model.
details: Our project uses Artificial Intelligence to control a smart butterfly model. The AI chip processes input signals and sends control signals through the transmitter and receiver. The battery supplies power, and the motor controls the butterfly movement. We developed this project using MATLAB Simulink. This project demonstrates the use of AI and electronic technology in automation.
